The exploration of the concavity-exponent question has reached the account it set out to give. The published question's part (a) (does beta*_n tend to 5/4, is every row (-5/4)-concave, is there a uniform beta) and part (c) (the regularity in the left layers) are answered at the continuum level, conditional on the same second-difference local-limit hypothesis H that the published upper-half arguments use: the layer profiles Phi_r have cusps sigma_r delta^((2r-7)/2) at their upper ends, the continuum local exponent tends to 2 at 1/3 and to infinity at 1/4 and 1/5, so no uniform beta exists and the heuristic left bound 2/3 holds only for Phi_3. In the resumed turn the equal-family observation was developed into a complete boundary-coefficient law with closed forms for every layer (c_r, sigma_r), proved by induction inside the continuum recursion and verified exactly for r <= 10 and numerically for r = 4, 5; the recursion was unrolled into a split-tree block formula (verified for r = 3, 4) whose node weights make both laws transparent (uniform-gap splitting probabilities summing to 1 at the lower end; the filler block as a right child with its feedback at the upper end), and the same unrolling of the exact recurrence gives an exact finite-n tree-sum formula for A_(n,k) (verified for n <= 9). The n^(-1/3) window and the invisibility of the cusps below n ~ 10^9 are explained by the soft-cap cost derived from the spine density (2 pi i)^(-1/2), and the consequence for the user's central question is stated: on the left half the surviving principle is the positivity of the margin, not uniform power concavity. What remains (a proof of H, the scaling function inside the boundary windows, closed forms of A_4, A_5, C_1, and the finite-n reading of the tree sum) are separate research programs that either require heavy computation the user asked to avoid or the same major proof the whole published upper-half program lacks; they are recorded with concrete starting points in the report. Continuing in this session would begin a new project rather than deepen the account of this question, so the work taken on is complete.

동료 역할의 일, 곧 생산자(s80031aad…)의 작업을 검증하고 넓혀 기록 후보로 만드는 일을 마쳤다. 노드 BVΘ₃는 미해결이며 기록도 그렇게 적었다. 이 턴의 수학적 진전: (1) 잎 잉여의 꼭짓점별 장부 e·ΔL_m = Σ_s c_m(s)ψ_k(s) + β_k(m)을 증명하고 두 엔진으로 상대 2·10^(−13) 안에서 확인했다. (2) 그 핵심인 Cayley 망원 항등식 Bor(j)(e·t(j)−j) = g(j−1)−g(j)를 증명했다. 이 항등식 때문에 기울임과 절단이 없으면 잔고가 0이다. (3) 정확한 값을 얻었다: 문턱 잔고 ψ_k(k) = e·u(k−1)−k, ψ_k(k+1)의 공식, 실극 극한 잔고의 닫힌 꼴 Φ_k(ρ̂_k), 그리고 임계 감쇠율 x₀ = 0.854를 가진 극한 함수 I(x). (4) 공표 c-sharp만으로 모든 잔고가 양수임을 증명했다(정리 P+). Φ_k(ρ_low) > 0은 k ≤ 100에서 정확 유리수로, k ≥ 101에서 해석적 하계로 보였다. 그 귀결로 잎 잉여의 하계를 얻었다. (5) 잔고의 지형과 띠별 분해를 관찰해, κ가 작은 까닭이 무거운 꼭짓점의 상당 부분이 잔고가 약 0.86·k^(−1/3)인 창 안에 있기 때문임을 보였다. 앞선 턴의 결과(독립 검산, 노드의 실제 범위에 맞춘 따름정리 8′과 가장 빠듯한 자리 k≈6667, 탄력도·실극과의 일치, 정정)와 함께 해설·record.json·증거를 갱신했고 전송 검사를 통과했다. 남은 두 방향은 직접 시도한 뒤 이 세션에서 더 나아갈 수 없다고 판단했다. 노드에 필요한 κ의 상계는 장부로 바꾸면 창 함수 Ω_k의 상계가 된다. 나는 재귀 (R)로 다시 쓰기, 성분 확률 합에서 나오는 상계, 수준 비와 Jensen 끼움을 거친 자기일관 부트스트랩을 시도했다. 모두 크기 방향 감쇠의 상계를 다시 요구하고, 상한 sup ψ로 하는 부트스트랩은 상수가 맞지 않는다(I(𝔰(1+κ))/√(2πk) ≈ 0.27 > κ). 조건 없는 잎 부등식에는 ζ₁(m) ≳ 0.49√(2πk)의 명시적 하계가 필요하다. 그러나 기울인 숲에는 결정론적 하계가 없고, 문턱 꼭짓점 수 E_νH를 거치는 길도 같은 창 비의 정보를 요구한다. 이 막힘의 정확한 꼴과 그것이 대상에 대해 말하는 것은 해설 §6.5, §7, §8에 적었다. 새 노드와 질문은 제안하지 않으며, 그 근거도 §8에 있다.

The session took on node (B) ul-core-odds-deficit as a whole and did not settle it. In this resumed turn it pursued the two obligations left by its own decomposition. For the share ratio f_n of the uniform-attachment growth probability it found that the per-landing factor rho(s) does not depend on the forest size, so the per-step change of f_n is a pure shift of the landing law with explicit factors (formula (4) in the report), and it verified that this change is at most 2.5e-3 of what the attachment-only version of (B) requires. It then tried to turn this into a proof by a Lipschitz induction on rho and showed exactly why that induction cannot close: the coefficient (3/2)*sup w exceeds 1, the global slope of rho (7/c^2, attained at the window front) is twenty times its slope where it matters (0.36/c^2 at the layer end), and the factor t_n exceeds 1 in the window. Closing it requires per-step bounds on p_{s-1}(c)/S_{s-1}(c) across the first layer, i.e. the quantitative first-layer survival asymptotics that the published records rdad8 already identify as the remaining technical core; the same asymptotics are needed for the leaf-excess increment bound. The session also proved the sign and an exact two-term decomposition of the leaf excess in the first layer (Theorem 3) by comparing the published landing representation with its uniform-attachment analogue, then found that the conclusion was already published in r8e3e9e586 (up to 2k+2) during this session; the proof and the formula are retained as an independent route. After this sustained effort, every remaining path to settling any new range of (B) runs through certified finite-c asymptotics of the first-layer survival probabilities, which this session has no method to obtain beyond what is already published. The retained work (report, glossary, evidence, outcome manifest) is complete and passes the transport check, and the report states the exact inequalities that would complete the argument.

탐색의 임무는 질문 tagged-tree-stochastic-order(마지막 차 자리 J의 확률적 순서 SO와 위험률 순서 HR이 왜 성립하는가)를 이해하고 그 이해를 남기는 것이었고, 그 임무는 역할 지침의 마침 기준(얻은 이해를 설명할 수 있고, 더 진지한 수학적 작업이 이해를 더하지 않는 지점)에 이르렀다. 얻은 것: (1) 크기 단조성만으로 양 끝 문턱 j ≤ c, j ≥ n−c의 HR이 나오고 오른쪽 절반 n ≤ 2c+1 전체의 HR·SO가 따른다(정리 1, 증명). (2) 나머지 문턱은 두 블록 부등식 (TB)=(공표 NBU_k) Pr(M≤k|J=m) ≥ Pr(M≤k)로 닫힌다(정리 2: (TB) ⟹ HR·SO, 증명). (3) 경계점 표현이 j = 2가 늘 가장 빠듯한 이유를 준다: 기울임의 두 통로(대칭 인자 R와 가중치 절단)가 b = 0에서 모두 1이다. (4) 끝점 (TB*)는 공표 c-hazard의 명시 위험률 하계로 2c+2 ≤ n ≤ n_H(c)에서 증명된다(정리 4; n_H/c → 5.009, 모든 c ≥ 29에서 4.5c까지). (5) 끝점에서 가운데로 가는 자연스러운 보조 성질(초과 수명 τ−c의 NBU, lr 최솟점이 n−c, BAL)은 모두 큰 k에서 거짓이고, 그 까닭은 임계 창의 위험률 봉우리가 0.59·c^(1/3)로 자라며 첫 층 골을 넘기 때문이다. 그래서 2c+1 < n ≤ 5c의 가운데 자리는 '깊은 창 대 얕은 창'의 위험률 합 비교로 정확히 남고, 공표 3/2 수준 하계로는 닿지 않는다. (6) 고정 k의 깊은 극 영역에서는 균등 법칙의 Borel 집중과 기울인 법칙의 균등화로 (DP)와 SO가 큰 n에서 성립함을 공표 극 점근 위에서 증명했다. (TB)의 실패 자리는 n* ≈ C_k·c^(3/2)(C_k ≈ 2.5–3.4)이며 노드 E의 창 꼭대기 2k^(3/2)의 약 1.3–1.7배다. (7) 경계점 양의 상관 BP는 FKG로 소인 수준 부등식에 환원된다(정리 3, 증명). 그 밖에 공표 r8e3e9e586의 '(NBU_k) 수치 위반 없음' 진술이 틀렸음을 정확 반례로 확인해 적었고, 경계점 확률의 k-단조라는 지름길이 N = 260에서 막힘을 확인했다. 남은 일은 보고서 §7에 적었다: 가운데 자리 (TB)에는 첫·둘째 층 생존의 명시 하계와 참 척도(≳3/c)의 깊은 위험률 하계가 필요하고, 극 영역의 유한 n에는 갱신 수렴의 명시 속도가 필요하다. 둘 다 이 프로젝트에서 알려진 장애(위험률의 참 척도 하계)이거나 사용자가 피하라고 한 대규모 인증 계산을 요구하므로, 이 세션에서 더 밀어도 이해가 더해지지 않는다고 판단한다. 질문 자체는 해소가 아니라 환원 상태로 남는다. 보고서·용어집·outcome.json·증거 파일을 갖추었고 전송 검사는 통과했다.

이 재개 턴에서 SC의 남은 명제를 끝까지 밀었다. (1) 비교 원리(정리 I)로 원자 조건을 미지의 양 없는 명시적 걸음 부등식으로 바꾸고, (2) 로그볼록성 가정 없이 원자 조건 ⟹ (C2′)를 증명했으며(정리 II), (3) 걸음 부등식의 두 조각을 모두 증명했다: 일차 계수 양성은 Ramanujan Q-함수의 부등식으로 환원해 Robbins·Flajolet 외·Adell–Jodrá의 정리와 정확 유리수(m ≤ 398)·인증 다항식 한계(m ≥ 399)로 닫았고(명제 F′), 1/k-볼록성은 네 항의 y-단조 명시 한계로 n ≤ 2000을 인증하고 n ≥ 2000을 결손 분포 꼬리의 적분 한계로 닫힌 꼴로 막았다(정리 III, 명제 V″). 그 결과 모든 k ≥ 3131에서 창 전체의 원자 조건과 (C2′)가 성립한다(정리 III′). 남은 (C1′)과 (C3′)는 바닥 조각의 죽인 조건부 평균 E[b|Z,n] = n·red(Z,n)/(Z+1)에 관한 두 단조성(red 비증가, n·red 증가)과 꼭대기 조각 평균의 한계 (ii)로 줄였고, 두 마디 구조로 기전을 가렸으며 수치로 창 전체에서 확인했다. 그러나 이 둘의 증명은 윗마디(Z ≲ √n)와 집중 벌크(Z ≳ √n)를 따로 다루는 새로운 정량 분석을 요구하고, 특히 (C3′)(i)의 수치 여유가 상대 0.1%대여서 이 세션이 쓴 명시 한계 기법(정밀도 ~10%)으로는 닫히지 않는다. 이 세션 안에서 더 나아갈 수 있는 의미 있는 길은 그 새 분석을 처음부터 세우는 것뿐이며, 그것은 지금까지의 작업을 모두 기록하고 후속 세션(또는 peer)에게 넘기는 것이 맞다고 판단한다. 모든 결과·수치·코드·문헌 확인 경로는 output/report.md(§2′.1–§2′.13), output/outcome.json, work/에 있다.

질문 monotone-tilt-leaves의 (i)(일반 비증가 g에서 추측 M 또는 잎 부등식의 증명·반증)는 닫히지 않았으므로 task_completed가 아니다. 재개한 탐색에서 더 할 수 있는 일을 끝까지 밀었다. 추측 S의 Strassen 조건을 n = 7(위집합 454개)과 n = 8(4,782,969개 숲, 위집합 270개)에서 확인했고, S가 속한 더 넓은 현상(대칭 양의 상관), 그 특수한 경우(윤곽 벡터의 양의 상관, 추측 U(a,b): 독립인 두 균등 숲의 합 ≼ 균등 숲; b = 1은 Fleurat 정리 1)와 거짓인 라벨 고정 진술들을 갈랐으며, 나무 수를 고정하면 깨진다는 사실로 무작위 나무 수가 필수임을 보였다. 정리 D로 S를 분할 수준의 진술 S-block과 (귀납 아래) 동치로 환원했고, 작동 조건이 τ_g의 로그 준가법성이 아님(계단 무게에서 깨지는데 S는 성립)을 확인했다. 증명 시도로는 격자 FKG(분할·조상 포함 순서는 분배 격자가 아님), 열 바스 사슬의 단조 결합(부분나무 크기 불일치), 세분 순서 양의 상관(E[f|π]가 세분 단조가 아님), Pitman 표현 + Harris 부등식(남는 보조정리 '삭제 단조성'이 n = 4의 별에서 거짓, 정확 최대 유량 109/125), 하향 곱 표현(모양 통계가 좌표에 단조가 아님)을 끝까지 따라갔고, 각각이 멈추는 자리를 정확히 적었다. 남은 핵심(일반 g의 SO, S-block, 대칭 양의 상관, U(a,b))은 Cayley 앙상블의 평균 뒤에만 나타나는 단조성을 쓰는 새 착상이 필요하고, 더 큰 계산은 이것을 결정하지 못한다. 이해한 바와 그 근거, 실패한 길의 실제 장애를 output/report.md(§4.9–4.12, §5–7), glossary-local.md, outcome.json에 적었고 transport check가 통과했다. 이 세션이 가진 수단으로 더 진전할 길이 없다고 판단해 종료한다.

peer 과제를 마쳤다. 생산자의 착지 급 작업을 공표 원문과 대조해, 중심 항등식들이 공표 볼록–꺾임 장부·명제 R·끝점 급 분해·꼭짓점 항등식·명제 LC의 재유도임을 정확한 사전으로 적었고, 남는 생산자 몫을 지위대로 남겼으며, 모든 항등식을 독립 코드로 정확 검산했다. 새 수학으로는 생존으로 기울인 나이 사슬이 h-변환으로 단조 결합을 가진다는 보조정리 H와, 그로부터 rc16c8db1이 DFR 추측의 남은 조각으로 꼽은(생산자 §6의 첫 남은 일이기도 한) 기울인 나이/착지 거리 단조성을 모든 DFR 법칙·모든 n에서 증명한 정리 M을 세웠다(n≤10 정확 유리수와 큰 n 수치로 확인). 이번 턴에서는 따름정리 M2의 서술을 '두 성질로의 환원'에서 정확한 국소화(골은 K≤K_*에서만)로 바로잡았고, K_*가 Borel에서 창 좌표 x≈1.53, 극한 E_x[R²]의 최댓값 x_T≈1.5(Monte Carlo)에 있음을 보였으며, 기하 낙차에서는 K_*가 먼 왼쪽에 있음을 정확한 곱 꼴로 보였다. re9a905a0의 기울인 출생 확률 θ̃·rfcc6c 정리 C와의 대응, 중복도 γ로의 확장, 실제 첫 층 사슬에서 정리 M이 깨지는 자리(크기 의존성과 욕조 위험률 가지, 공표 3/4 경계와 일치)도 적었다. 남은 것(기울인 동률률의 K_* 뒤 감소 증명, re9a905a0 (α)의 G 단조성, 벌크의 얇은 d≥0)은 노드급 연구 과제로 기록에 정확히 적었다. transport check 통과.

The peer assignment, developing the q0 exploration's retained work into a record, is complete. The producer's claims were re-checked with independent code (brute-force parking, forest and recursive-forest enumeration, exact recomputation of every counterexample and closed form). Re-derivations of published results are attributed, and five errors are corrected (affine-lemma edge condition, the S(0) interpretation, the n/4 mode, a curvature bound, and my own layer-index slip). The comparison model is extended with proved results: the exact first-layer recursion and a theorem that the uniform-attachment forest's first layer decreases for every n; the closed-form first-layer limit and its log-concavity; the exact layer expansion (Dickman correspondence); the exact n-direction identity, under which each layer is a forced first-order recursion. Also added: the attach-only chain and drift decomposition for the Cayley forest; the observation that uniform-attachment rows are log-concave up to n=600, with the tightest point always at the layer boundary k=n/2 (where Cayley log-concavity fails from n=80); and a quantitative explanation of that point via second-layer quadrature, which matches finite-n margins to 3-4 digits and shows that the two-heavy-tree term carries log-concavity below 1/2. The remaining directions (finite-n log-concavity proofs, second- and third-layer finite-n bounds, unimodality of the limit density) are long technical projects. They are stated precisely in the proposed question and the open-problems section rather than left implicit. The root and q0 remain unresolved; the record does not claim otherwise.

The node (decay-33-20, all k >= 3131) is not closed; it is proved for 3131 <= k <= 10^7 (Theorems 1-2, all N >= k). In this resumed turn I pursued the open part k > 10^7 along every route I could find beyond the one-sided induction that gave Theorems 1-2: two-sided rate hypotheses (upper and lower bounds on rho_n), window-average decay hypotheses, strengthened hypotheses rho_n <= lambda(1 - phi(n)) with decreasing phi, left-growth and mixed pairings in the last-car identity, a renewal-theoretic sandwich on the pole-tilted sequence u_n = a_n e^(sigma_k n/k), and explicit bounds on the tail primes d_j (j > k) from the published recursion. Each was carried to the point where it either closed or failed for a structural reason recorded in report.md sections 3.7-3.8 and 5: rate hypotheses cannot be propagated for windows shorter than the big-block scale k; decreasing strengthenings are self-financing because the bulk weights are unknown one-sidedly; the pairing alternatives cascade into the Cayley-left-part region with cost proportional to sqrt(k). What was gained is rigorous: Proposition T (flatness of the tail primes on the k^(2/3) scale, with the first-moment identity), and Lemma W / Corollary W, which state the exact two-sided input that closes E: a sandwich L <= u_n <= U for n >= k, whose conditions L*P_N <= Cay_N <= U*P_N involve only Cayley values and tail primes of length k < j <= 1.5k, with the extremes in the first layer (N ~ 1.01k and 1.42k). Numerically the best ratio U/L is 2.9 while the proof tolerates 10 (giving E to k <= 10^10) or 3 (to 10^35). The single missing ingredient is an explicit, k-uniform upper bound on d_(k+s) for s <= k that follows the saddle-point rate of the recursion (a single-exponential ansatz provably cannot work for large k because its admissible exponent falls below sigma_k, and the true profile is flat on k^(2/3) and then decays on k^(3/4) with local rate rising from 4.2 to about 12). Establishing that bound and then bounding Cay_N/P_N uniformly in k is a separate analytic program of several pages of tight inequalities (the margin at the critical points is a factor 3.5), of the same kind the published record rbe3f3fa2 stopped at; I judge, after the above effort, that I cannot complete it reliably in this session. The remaining increments that I could complete (extending the certificate to about 3*10^9 by inserting Proposition T, or proving the higher-tilt statement for k <= 2*10^4) are finite-range extensions that the user's 2026-11-09 decision asked us not to prioritize, and they do not change the structure. The report, glossary and outcome record the theorems, the proven lemmas, the numerical evidence with code, and the precise remaining obligation for a successor.

The peer work taken on was to develop attempt s25fcc9a3c3744c428596a53a84b82c29's whole-node work on onelevel-attachment into a record candidate. That is done: output/record.json, a Korean exposition and evidence under output/, and the transport check passes. In this turn the outer-band theorem BX was sharpened from m>=ceil(2.17k) to m>=ceil(2.135k) for k>=6668. The improvement comes from treating the window bottom [k,1.025k) as one block through W_N=s_N B_N/x* and the published survival upper bound r1ba4f0b0/c-lemma-B. The closed-form bounds were evaluated with mpmath (C1=0.0081, C2=0.0654 at k=6668, monotone in k) and cross-checked by a discrete sum. The first row m=2k+1 is now credited to the published r0cece/c-onelevel-first-row, and the two proposed band nodes were narrowed to start at m=2k+2. The node itself stays unresolved. Its remaining parts are proposed as three nodes plus a covering relation: the inner band, 3131<=k<=6667, and the hazard inequality HZ+. Each needs a different method, and the exposition states why. The record explains that the reach of BX is limited by the published pointwise bound K' just above the window, and that the true threshold sits where the environment loses about 12% of its survival. Further gains available here are only marginal: a new survival lower bound would lower alpha0 to about 0.11 and leave the inner band t<~1 untouched. (2) I proved that column log-concavity (CLC, numerically verified exactly for k<=10, N<=60 and at 60 digits for k<=20, N<=300) implies the pointwise asymptotics S_N(k) ~ (2/(k+1))(N+1)R_k^{-N-1}. All three asks of the question received substantive answers with evidence: (1) a uniform exact representation, the epsilon-expansion around the separatrix of the Riccati family (Theorem A, proved), together with the exact cumulant structure of the layer index in the pole regime (Theorem B, derived from the published Mittag-Leffler expansion and verified to three digits for k=12..45, x>=2); (2) the handover scale read two ways, as the layer-distribution variance (n+1)beta_k(1-lambda_k+beta_k) reaching 1 and as the departure of the true log-concavity ratio from its single-pole value, with the further observation that for k below about 10^4 no part of layer 3 is in the layer regime; (3) a sign-determining quantity, the exact criterion mu>=0 iff -Delta^2 log A <= 2 log cosh(mean log-slope), with explicit limits in the pole regime (1-2/(x s_k)) and in the layer limit (Phi_r Phi_r''/Phi_r'^2 >= 1/2 on x>=2.3 from the published closed form of Phi_3), supported by exact log-concavity of the cumulative counts at all 79400 positions for n<=400 and by the tilted-measure reading in which the kink term k E[H] carries the log-concavity for k>=20. Along the way an earlier interpretation (intrinsic concavity of the landing layers) was tested and withdrawn in favour of the product-rule explanation, and the claim that the exact counts b are log-concave was tested and corrected (it fails from n=80 in a window right of n/2). The peer task, developing explorer s2893957's work on the question layer-pole-handover into a record, is complete. The candidate passes the transport check. (1) I verified the producer's work with independent code. Theorem A was checked for k=2,3,6,12, and the k=2 case is the classical Fubini series. I re-derived Theorem B and reproduced the beta_k and lambda_k constants and one point of the sign-margin table. (2) I proved that the expansion is a renewal equation, F_k=F_{a0}/(1-phi_k) with phi_k(rho_k)=1. This gives exact formulas: each layer is T_m=R_n(N/m)Pr(S_m=N), and 1/q equals a log-weighted local renewal function. Theorem B is the renewal central limit theorem. I also proved 0<lambda_k<1, an exact identity for log eps_k, and a hazard representation of the block law: E[e^{sB}]=J_k(rho)/J_k(rho e^s), the reciprocal survival function of the log-overshoot. (3) Corrections: by Pringsheim's theorem, every layer T_m is negative for infinitely many n when k>=3, so the producer's positivity observation holds only on its finite range. The producer's assumption that the cumulative count is log-concave in k is false, as published record r059f11ed shows (I reproduced the n=780 counterexample), and it fails on the left half too. The kink-versus-overdispersion mechanism is a rediscovery of r059f11ed. The producer's statement about the separatrix coefficients is wrong from n near k/2, and the m=0 term grows with k. (4) New numerical findings: the transient and comb period are set by the part of the block spread that breaks the lattice (0.62-0.67 of the variance), not by the full variance. The comb period falls below the block mean for k>=128 (1.14 vs 1.25 at k=256), and CV^2 sigma_k^2 keeps growing, so the published heat-kernel time is not the block-variance parameter. The simplest hierarchy dictionary for the layer index is refuted by the trend up to k=96, while the producer's landing law holds to k=96. What remains is the k->infinity scaling of the block law, needed to derive the layer limit Phi_r from the exact representation. That is a deep asymptotic problem, and I have stated its exact form in sections 3.7 and 4.4. It belongs to the open question for a later explorer, not to finishing this record. The question is left open, with no resolution proposed.

The record then adds the c3 behaviour outside the node's window: a new closed form rho(beta k)/k -> 2beta(1-beta)/(1+beta)^2, a rigorous limit theorem showing c3 fails in the first-layer bulk for Z >~ 2/lambda (compounding of kills over a condensed gap), explicit failures at k=1e5 and 2e5 by two independent implementations with an a priori error bound, and a match with the published window-limit model, whose c3 boundary is x* ~ 7. What remains is either held by another pipeline (c1) or not needed by the node or by SC: an explicit k-threshold for the bulk failure, and a rigorous version of the window-limit crossover. Both are recorded as open.

The peer record for the q0 exploration s90ce022 is complete and passes the transport check (27 claims, 7 local terms, evidence for producer, first peer and this peer). Across both turns I read the producer's report, transcript and code and the cancelled first peer's draft, re-derived the producer's ISM theorem, confirmed the first peer's discovery of the reversed midpoint inequality and its corrected proof (independent 40-digit interval re-check to n=400), and repositioned the draft against published work it had missed (node Q, the S1 mu-monotonicity route of r1b79fab, the endpoint concavity and third-order local limits of r1aa0be6). New mathematics: PC implies mu non-increasing with an explicit slack and the exact descent-side chain PC => mu-monotone => concave => Q => persistence; the ISM satisfies S1 for every n>=7 and its row is log-concave for every n>=3 (one inequality rho_s>=e^{-m_s} plus concavity of log(1-e^{-m}); n<=400 certified); exact computation to n=500 locating every failure of row log-concavity, S1 and whole-row PC before the mode (first PC failure n=494); the bulk contrast hazard-driven vs curvature-driven (n^2 mu -> g''/g); window identities giving the mode and the log-concavity boundaries through the tilted Brownian-area law; an unconditional proof that the PC limit margin has the right sign near the top (x<=0.4766) and the resulting informal theorem that PC holds on every compact window interval for large n; and Proposition 4.2' deriving from the published inequality mu_1 mu_3<(3/2)mu_2^2 that density log-concavity, mu-monotonicity and cumulative log-concavity hold on the whole after-mode side (and beyond, to y=2 and y=2.29), while the actual failure thresholds (y=2.67, 3.69, 4.27) lie before the mode. These are assembled into a shape-property map that answers, at the level this material allows, where and why the true row departs from the mean-field mechanism. What remains is recorded exactly in section 7: PC+ for all n (an attempt-type proof needing uniformity at the top of the row), log-convexity of the limit survival beyond x=3 (a range certification the user conditions discourage), and the layer-by-layer analogue of the bulk contrast, which is the subject of published layer records. Further work within the peer role would be range extension or attempt-scale proof rather than development of the producer's retained work.

The peer task was to develop the producer's retained work on node SC (first-layer-single-sign-change) into a coherent, verified record candidate with a Korean exposition. That is done, and the transport check passes (ok, no errors). Verification and correction: I diagnosed and confirmed the producer's float-engine bug. My independent engine matches the corrected engine and published r5c5975f9. I checked SC exactly for 3<=k<=100. Producer obstacle 4 is corrected: the odds normalization does have a landing-bridge form (Prop 7 bridge dictionary, checked exactly). The real obstacle is strict submodularity of the integrand. Attributions to published claims are listed. Extensions: I completed the limit criteria table, with all five conditions proved in the limit, the Psi ladder and the CV^2<1/2 thresholds. I gave the step split and the ratio split of the crossing. Prop 8 lowers the remaining window end to k+D_pos(k)-1, with D_pos(k)<=floor(k^(2/3))-62 for 3131<=k<=20000. Prop 9 proves the reduction RowLC and DG imply SC. RowLC and DG are proposed as nodes with measured margins, together with an anatomy of DG (tilt plus intrinsic terms) and a concrete proof route. The frontier standing is updated through revision 432: zsplit-c3 was proved by r9c678a73, so zsplit-c1 alone gives SC; zsplit-c1 is still open after rfa72be97. SC itself remains unproved. Proving RowLC or DG is new attempt-level work that this record delineates, not part of the peer task.

The candidate develops the explorer's retained work into a full record. Every explorer claim is mapped to its published antecedents, and the claims the peer re-ran were confirmed by independent code. In this turn the peer added three things. (1) The identity x(f+F)=Pr(Y+A'>=1/x): the published layer forcing K is the distribution function of the sum of two independent variables. (2) An exact decomposition of (F/f)'' that yields a convexity criterion. With it, (V_inf) is proved on [1/3,1) by hand and on [1/4,1) with a 3-second 30-digit cell check of closed-form bounds, so the proof now covers the layer containing the mode. (3) A convolution layer recursion that gives the limit to about 13 digits: mode 0.25258478162. This exposed 1-2% errors in the explorer's Volterra values and corrected the constant-tilt mode statement (92% of the mean-field miss explained, not 99.7%). Several exact reformulations reduce the remaining part of question (a), monotonicity on (0,1/4], to statements about the law of Y, checked numerically with wide margins: Y+A' is IFR, psi/Pr(S>=s) is decreasing, and zeta(s) is nearly linear. Proving those tail statements needs new asymptotic control of zeta'' from the nonlinear limit equation. Proving f'(1/4)>0 rigorously needs a precision enclosure (margin about 3%). Transferring the results to finite n needs uniform error estimates. These are separate research projects beyond developing this source, and they are stated as exact remainders in exposition section 6. Transport check passes.

The peer task (develop attempt s41d9df8's retained work on node hazard-beyond-2k into a record candidate) is complete. The candidate verifies and corrects the producer's Theorem A, proves Lemma P (near-single-tree mass lambda(1-O(k^-1/2))), Theorem A' and Corollary B' (HZ+ for all k>=6668, 2k<=N<=floor(5k/2)), and in this turn adds Corollary C: localizing the published Theorem FR gives lambda_k(m)>=0 for k>=6668, 3k<=m<=floor(7k/2)+2 (with BX, ceil(427k/200)<=m<=floor(7k/2)+2) on node onelevel-attachment. It explains why the method stops at phi^2 k, explains the reduction's 5/2 criticality as self-reference (identity T_z, ledger), and shows by computation that the valley-mass bound and the discarded first-layer surplus need the same missing input: an explicit first-to-second-layer survival ratio of order sqrt(k), i.e. a once-branching heavy-structure analogue of heavy-path-recurrence. That input is a separate research program, recorded as the open node hz-beyond-5k2 via a proposed split relation. The transport check passes; updates through revision 435 do not affect the record.

sections.statement: root와 같은 원 주차 과정(차 1,…,n이 번호 순서로 도착하고, 차 i는 선호 a_i∈{1,…,n}이 비어 있으면 그곳에, 차 있으면 그 오른쪽 첫 빈자리에 주차)에서 PF_n은 모든 차가 성공하는 선호 목록의 집합, s_i는 차 i가 실제로 주차한 자리, M(α)=max_i(s_i−a_i), b_(n,ℓ)=#{α∈PF_n:M(α)=ℓ}(ℓ≥n이면 0)이다. 10001≤n≤20000인 모든 정수 n에서 m=⌈n/2⌉라 두면, 0≤i<j<m이고 j≤n−2인 어떤 정수 i,j에 대해서도 b_(n,i)>b_(n,i+1)과 b_(n,j)<b_(n,j+1)이 동시에 성립하지 않는다. (이 위치들은 노드 범위 max(2k+1,10001)≤n<N♭_k 안에 있고(k≥10000에서 2k+2≥20002이고 N♭_k≥0.26k²>2k+2), 공표 잔여 𝓡_L={k≥2001, max(2k+1,20001)≤n<min(N♭_k,N_k)} 안에 있다. 중앙 n∈{2k−1,2k}에 바로 이웃한 왼쪽 두 대각선이다. 이 절은 중앙 증가의 명시적 증명(rce3dc75b9fc040fd8925fa3a73b0d753)의 수직선 윤곽·Hermite 수축·부분적분 기법을, r8d6850af987244b6b8e2bd46d3078fe0이 n≤2k+2에서 증명한 구조 d_(n,k)≥h_low=POS−J^G(두 차 동률 수의 두 배에서 무제한 Green 원자를 뺀 것)와 결합하여, 모든 k≥10000에서 명시적 문턱으로 증명하려는 것이다.)

노드 W_L♭(left-residual-reduced)의 원 주차 과정과 기호 아래, k≥10000인 모든 정수 k와 n∈{2k+3, 2k+4}인 모든 정수 n에 대해 b_(n,k−1)≤b_(n,k)이다. (이 위치들은 노드 범위 max(2k+1,10001)≤n<N♭_k와 공표 잔여 𝓡_L 안에 있다. 이 세션의 첫 절(n∈{2k+1,2k+2})에 이어지는 다음 두 왼쪽 대각선이다. 접근: 모든 n에서 성립하는 공표 부등식 d_(n,k)≥𝒦''_(n,k)(k)−J^G_n(r8d6850af987244b6b8e2bd46d3078fe0/green-marker-majorant-all-n)에, 종결 숲 사슬 해 F_*에 대한 얼린 용량 다항식의 초과 X=E−F_*가 세 개의 무거운 블록이 없는 차수(<3k+3)에서 X≡e^(T_≤k)[c∫X+(c∫Z−T_>k)²/2]를 만족한다는 정확 항등식을 결합해 n=2k+3,2k+4에서 𝒦''(k)≥n![x^n]Φ(T(x))를 증명하고, 이어 첫 절과 같은 수직선 윤곽·Hermite 명시 경계를 ν=3,4로 옮기려는 것이다.)

(이 위치들은 노드 범위 max(2k+1,10001)≤n<N♭_k와 공표 잔여 𝓡_L 안에 있다. 이 세션의 앞 두 절(n−2k∈{1,2,3,4})에 이어지는 띠이다. 접근: 사슬 초과 X=E−F_*의 정확 항등식 X≡e^(T_≤k)[c∫X+(c∫Z−T_>k)²/2]를 Neumann 급수 X=Σ_j c^j(e^(T_≤k)∫)^j[e^(T_≤k)(c∫Z−T_>k)²/2]로 풀어, c=k에서의 이계 도함수가 블록 쌍별 양의 항들의 양의 합임을 Pr_(k+a−1)(M≥k)≤a(a−1)/(2(k+1))과 Z≤a−1의 초등 경계로 보여 𝒦''_(n,k)(k)≥POS'_n을 얻고, 공표 d≥𝒦''(k)−J^G와 앞 두 절의 ν-일반 수직선·Hermite 명시 경계(ν=n−2k)를 ν≤19로 확장한 정확 유리수 감사를 결합하려는 것이다. 위끝 19는 현재 거친 잔차 상계로 해석적 여유가 남는 한계이다.)
